name: OpenAI
about: Watches the OpenAI API services CMiC's AI features call; an outage makes CMiC AI features fail for customers using OpenAI.
details: Reads status.openai.com and keeps only incidents on the APIs CMiC's AI features call (such as Chat Completions, Responses and Files); ChatGPT-only incidents are ignored. During an incident, CMiC AI features can return errors or time out. Customers set up with Azure OpenAI instead are covered by the Microsoft tile.
label: :robot_face: *OpenAI Status*
